title: SpawnEggDrops
description: Provides a rare chance for mobs to drop their spawn eggs. Good eatin'!
body:
# SpawnEggDrops
# This mod has been integrated into my consolidated mod, crdtrd's mood! [Check it out!](https://modrinth.com/mod/crdtrdsmood)
This was done to make maintaining my mods easier. Versions for Minecraft 26.1.2+ are available there.
## Summary
A server side fabric mod that makes it so mobs have a small very chance to drop their respective spawn eggs, affected by looting.
## Features
- Kill mobs, get their spawn.
- Gruesome yes but how else would it make sense to obtain spawn eggs in survival?
- What you do with them is up to you. May I suggest using them on a spawner? ;)
## Requirements
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
